title: Algebraic closures across an algebraic field extension
statement: Let $K\to L$ be an algebraic extension of fields: every element of $L$ is a root of a nonzero polynomial over $K$ [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-algebraic-element]. Let $\Omega_K$ be an algebraic closure of $K$ and $\Omega_L$ an algebraic closure of $L$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Give $\Omega_L$ its $K$-algebra structure by the composite $K\to L\to\Omega_L$. There exists a field isomorphism $a:\Omega_L\xrightarrow{\sim}\Omega_K$ whose restriction to $K$ is the specified structure homomorphism $K\to\Omega_K$.
